figures.name: An

ability.name: Heaven's Court
ability.description: All ally abilities that require approval now auto-succeed; enemy divine abilities are suppressed.

figures.description: Distant sky god and father of all Sumerian deities who dwells in the highest heaven.

figures.name: Enlil

ability.name: Tablet of Destinies
ability.description: Determine one enemy's fate: they lose their most powerful ability permanently.

figures.description: Lord of the wind and storms who holds the Tablet of Destinies, granting him power over all creation.

figures.name: Inanna

ability.name: Queen of Heaven and Earth
ability.description: Inanna descends: this card loses and then regains +5 to all stats as she returns from the underworld.

figures.description: Fierce queen of heaven and earth who descended to the underworld, died and rose again, reigning over love and war.

figures.name: Enki

ability.name: Abzu's Wisdom
ability.description: Grant all allies +3 to magic and wisdom; create a trick to save one ally from destruction.

figures.description: God of the sweet underground waters and human wisdom who protects humanity and outwits other gods.

figures.name: Nanna

ability.name: Lunar Calendar
ability.description: All timing-based abilities trigger at the optimal time for your side for 2 turns.

figures.description: Moon god who measures time, governs cattle and whose light guides travelers through the night.

figures.name: Utu

ability.name: Sun's Truth
ability.description: No enemy can use deception or disguise abilities while Utu shines; deal 5 to dark cards.

figures.description: Sun god of justice who crosses the sky daily and judges all human deeds with perfect fairness.

figures.name: Ninhursag

ability.name: Mother's Healing
ability.description: Restore 5 HP to one critically wounded ally; grant all allies +1 defense.

figures.description: Great mother goddess of the earth who nursed the gods, healed Enki and created animals and humans.

figures.name: Ereshkigal

ability.name: Queen of the Great Below
ability.description: Remove one enemy from play for 2 turns; they return with -3 to all stats.

figures.description: Queen of the underworld whose realm of no return claims all who descend — even her sister Inanna.

figures.name: Gilgamesh

ability.name: Two-Thirds Divine
ability.description: Deal 8 damage; after combat restore this card's HP to half regardless of damage taken.

figures.description: King of Uruk and greatest Sumerian hero who fought monsters, befriended Enkidu and sought immortality.

figures.name: Enkidu

ability.name: Wild Strength
ability.description: When allied with a hero card, both gain +3 to all stats from legendary friendship.

figures.description: The wild man created from clay who became Gilgamesh's soul-companion and faced the Bull of Heaven.

figures.name: Nergal

ability.name: Plague King
ability.description: Inflict plague on all enemies: each loses 2 HP per turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: God of death, plague and the midday sun who became king of the underworld after seducing Ereshkigal.

figures.name: Dumuzi

ability.name: Seasonal Cycle
ability.description: Every other turn this card gains +3 to all stats; opposing turns it loses 2 (death and rebirth).

figures.description: Shepherd god and Inanna's husband who descends to the underworld for half the year causing winter.

figures.name: Humbaba

ability.name: Cedar Breath
ability.description: Inflict terror on all enemies: they cannot advance or charge for 1 turn.

figures.description: Terrifying guardian of the Cedar Forest whose face is a mass of intestines and whose roar is a flood.

figures.name: Bull of Heaven

ability.name: Celestial Stamp
ability.description: When this card attacks, deal 2 damage to all allies and enemies from cosmic trembling.

figures.description: The divine bull sent by An at Inanna's request who caused seven years of drought by breathing fire.

figures.name: Anzu Bird

ability.name: Tablet Theft
ability.description: Steal one enemy special ability and use it immediately.

figures.description: The lion-headed storm eagle who stole the Tablet of Destinies from Enlil, plunging the world into chaos.

figures.name: Namtar

ability.name: Fate Messenger
ability.description: Deliver a curse: one enemy cannot heal or gain HP for 2 turns.

figures.description: The personification of fate and messenger of death who carries out Ereshkigal's decrees in the underworld.

figures.name: Lugalbanda

ability.name: Swift King
ability.description: This card acts first every turn regardless of speed stats.

figures.description: Legendary king of Uruk and Gilgamesh's divine father who received the gift of supernatural speed from the Anzu.

figures.name: Utnapishtim

ability.name: Immortal Waters
ability.description: Grant one ally immortality for 1 turn: they cannot be destroyed during this time.

figures.description: The Babylonian flood hero given immortality by the gods, the only mortal to achieve eternal life — guarding its secret.

figures.name: Erra

ability.name: Plague of War
ability.description: Deal 3 damage to all cards on the field — ally and enemy alike.

figures.description: Violent god of plague and war who nearly destroyed civilization in a fit of restless destruction.

figures.name: Lama

ability.name: Divine Intercession
ability.description: Guarantee one ally's next ability succeeds regardless of enemy resistance.

figures.description: The personal guardian spirit (Lama) who stands between humans and the divine, interceding on their behalf.
